experienceData.description: Worked on a healthcare revenue-cycle platform that converts EOB documents into X12 835 ERA files and gives operations teams upload, review, and correction flows.
responsibilities: Built payer-specific document parsers and EDI generation pipelines for healthcare revenue-cycle operations
Developed full-stack product features, dashboard tools, and security controls across React, TypeScript, and Go
Maintained production model integration, error logging, and regression testing suites
achievements: Raised field-extraction accuracy from roughly 55% to 95% on evaluated payer workflows through 19 payer-specific Python parsers, expanding EOB-to-ERA support from 44 to 71 formats.
Corrected X12 835 output across 44 ERA generators by deriving missing payment fields and reconciling claim and service-line totals. 108 regression tests passed.
Restored production document processing after an Amazon Bedrock model upgrade by removing unsupported parameters, correcting system-message order, and adding payer-classification error logging.

Delivered 40+ product and security changes through five stakeholder reviews, including an 8-KPI React dashboard, virtualized tables, bulk actions, organization-scoped RBAC, and signed-file access for PHI.
